During FY26 it launched Rashmi Icon and commenced Rashmi Avenue while delivering two completed redevelopment projects, taking its portfolio to around 7.5 lakh sq. ft. of construction area under various stages of development. risks.note: The auditors state that redevelopment projects are exposed to risks relating to regulatory approvals, which may significantly impact the recoverability and valuation of inventory. Audit procedures included reviewing project approvals, commencement certificates and occupation certificates to assess the status of projects and potential risks impacting project completion.
risks.risk: Regulatory approval risk on redevelopment projects

risks.note: Explicitly named as an exposure for the Company's redevelopment projects; changes in development control regulations can alter project economics and buildable potential in Mumbai's redevelopment micro-markets.

Redevelopment carries obligations towards society members / existing occupants, including rehabilitation and transit accommodation costs that form part of attributable land and development rights costs — an obligation structurally specific to the redevelopment model.
risks.risk: Contractual obligations towards society members and existing occupants

risks.note: Named as an exposure of redevelopment projects; delays in the stage of physical completion affect cost to complete and the recoverability of inventory carried against long-dated projects.

Cost escalations are named as a risk; inventory valuation depends on management estimates of total projected construction and redevelopment costs to complete, so escalation directly compresses realisable margin.
The determination of inventory carrying value requires management to estimate future selling prices and expected market demand; adverse movement in either would affect net realisable value.
risks.risk: Changing market conditions affecting selling prices and demand

risks.note: Inventory valuation of redevelopment projects under construction and completed units held for sale was flagged as a Key Audit Matter because it involves significant management judgment and estimation uncertainty due to the long-term and complex nature of such projects, together with the materiality of the balance.
risks.risk: Estimation uncertainty in inventory valuation (Key Audit Matter)

risks.note: The auditors reviewed correspondence relating to material litigations, disputes and claims with contractors, society members, regulatory authorities and other stakeholders that could affect project costs or realizability.
risks.risk: Litigation, disputes and claims with contractors, society members and regulatory authorities
